Missing Kruger Millions

By: Marion Edmunds | Paid

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
we exposed a Chartered Accountant who turned on her clients to abuse their personal information, their bank accounts and their trust to make millions of their money disappear

Unique Selling Point:
We have extraordinary access to a forensic paper trail of fraud and the victims.

Summary:
This story is about Renee Kruger, a Pretoria accountant who appears to have had a mid-life crisis after her divorce and gone rogue. From being a straight-laced classy Pretoria professional she appears to have become a bit of a vamp with tattoos, mini-skirts and a younger boyfriend, allegedly with a criminal record. But that is not the main problem. The story is about how she turned on trusted clients and siphoned of millions of rands of their money, specifically from deceased estates, while she and her assistant Jacqueline Pretorius were entrusted with managing their financial affairs. She and Jacqueline now accuse each other for the trail of theft after they fell out in March. Renee is the older, experienced company owner, Jacqueline plays the young, naieve and trusting bookkeeper who was implicated without her consent and knowledge. Neither version is completely believable.

Untangling the mess is a forensic tax investigator, Hannes Ollewagen. And while he acknowledges that this is an audacious and complex systematic act of fraud, he says it comes in the context of increased abuse of clients by the very people entrusted with their life savings, their trusts and their business accounts. And it appears that one of the regulators that manages the financial industry, the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants, SAICA, stands by and is slow to act against those who have privileged access to other people's bank accounts and personal information, such as ID's and company records.




Further information:
We have three case studies lined up talk on camera, although I did have off the record conversations with six parties (eight people).
1) Dr Marius De Beer. His parents saved up money for a trust of R1.2 million for his seriously disabled child for after they had passed. Renee Kruger looted the trust fund, leaving R25-thousand. He also did his taxes, and when he started scratching, he found that she had done nothing despite paying monthly for her services and that he now owed SARS huge penalties. SARS is now deducting R17 000 from his salary monthly to make good those penalities. While he battles this, he has had to sell his car.
2) Wanda Blignaut – Renee Kruger stole R100-000 from her husband’s deceased estate – she saw an article about Renee and came forward to volunteer her story
3) Dr Johan Klopper – a close friend of Renee’s who used to go on holiday with her, part of her inner circle. They discovered that she drew R300 000 from his deceased mother’s estate, and have subsequently got threatening phone calls and are victims of a harassment campaign by her boyfriend, Dawid van Jaarsveld.

Hannes Olwegen says he can not comment on the case as such as he will be an expert witness in the case. However, as he is a player in this story and I think quite an interesting personality as a foil to the flamboyant Renee Kruger (straight-laced, forensic focus, deliberate and by the book) I have asked him to do an interview which helps to place this case in the context of this type of crime which he says is rife because they are inundated with requests for help from all over the country.

A further potential interview/on shoot call could go to Costa Adrianis, a person who runs a hitman agency. Apparently he has been hired/asked by Renées boyfriend to phone up people to intimidate them with death threats. I have his number.

There are a number of complicated issues to resolve specifically how to handle Jacqueline Pretorius, how to manage Renée Kruger's confront and also how to manage the first case study Dr Johan Klopper and Morné Kruger, who are more deeply embroiled in the saga on an emotional level because they were once close family friends with Renée and boyfriend, part of a party set that went sour. Hannes is also a little unsure about them. But they have a good story to tell.

Finally, I am being sent a lot of voice recordings of Renées conversations with her clients, some of whom don't want to be on camera. What is best ethical practice here?






Extra Budget Items:
I will be away from my base so will need flight, accommodation, vehicle and S and T. I will hire crew in Pretoria. I am also not sure how possible this is to do in two days given that some of the time would be spent hunting Renee.

Press Release:


Cooking the Books
In the leafy suburbs of Pretoria, there’s a growing tide of mistrust and frustration as a once-respected chartered accountant finds herself in the midst of a forensic investigation. Her disheartened clients allege disturbing delays and puzzling bank withdrawals in the winding up of deceased estates. The investigator is sifting through mountains of paperwork and bank accounts, tracking transactions that link this sophisticated, jet-setting professional and her bookkeeper to a web of hidden irregularities. These allegedly include forged signatures and stolen identities, mysterious changes in company papers and unexplained cash withdrawals and deposits. But this alleged scamster wasn’t just taking from any client: she seemingly targeted those at their most vulnerable – long-time clients and friends dealing with the passing of a loved one. While both the accountant and the bookkeeper have gone to ground, they blame each other for the crimes and misdemeanours of which they stand accused. Carte Blanche investigates.



Producer: Marion Edmunds | Presenter: Govan Whittles

Script:


KRUGER MILLIONS #6547 FINAL SCRIPT
PRETORIA, JACARANDA CITY…
IT’S HOME TO MANY PROFESSIONALS AND BUSINESS PEOPLE WHO WANT TO KEEP THEIR FINANCIAL AFFAIRS TIDY.
AND THIS IS WHERE THE STORY OF RENE KRUGER AND THE MISSING MILLIONS BEGINS…
IT’S A SAGA OF COMPLEX FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS AROUND DECEASED ESTATES…
FACILITATED BY A CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT WHO RELISHED HOLIDAYS AND THE HIGH LIFE.

PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles:
For years, accountant Rene Kruger had been handling the books of professionals in Pretoria.
Through many tax seasons, she had got to know them well – and they her.
But recently, it had become clear to at least some of her clients that things were just not adding up.

DR MARIUS DE BEER PLACED HIS FAMILY’S FINANCES WITH RENÉ KRUGER’S SMALL BUSINESS OVER TEN YEARS AGO.

SO WHEN HIS MOTHER PASSED AWAY IN 2018, IT SEEMED SENSIBLE TO APPOINT RENÉ AS EXECUTOR OF THE ESTATE, PAYING HER TO DO THE COMPLICATED PAPERWORK REQUIRED BY LAW TO SHIFT HIS INHERITANCE INTO HIS HANDS.
THE INHERITANCE WAS IN PART EARMARKED FOR LIFELONG CARE FOR HIS SERIOUSLY DISABLED SON.

Dr Marius De Beer
It has a very special memory for us that they were able to do that. They spend their lives very disciplined when it came to finances and spending and all that.

HOWEVER, MARIUS BECAME UNEASY BECAUSE OVER MONTHS THERE WAS NO MOVEMENT IN THE WRAPPING UP OF THE ESTATE.
AND HE WAS CONTINUALLY FOBBED OFF WHEN HE MADE INQUIRIES.

Dr Marius De Beer: This is one of the correspondences that I had with Rene regarding my mom's estate where she basically tells me that look, we have to be very patient, it takes long for SARS
Govan Whittles: That was obviously just a delaying tactic
Dr Marius De Beer: That was a delaying tactic, ja.

THEN RENE TOLD HIM SARS WANTED HIM TO PAY A SIGNIFICANT CAPITAL GAINS TAX - WHICH IS A TAX LEVIED ON THE PROFIT MADE FROM THE DISPOSAL OF AN ASSET, LIKE A PROPERTY.

Govan Whittles: So at that point, how much money was tied up in your mom's estate?
Marius De Beer: Roughly around 1.2 million. And it was, for me at the time, a very surrealistic moment when I heard that the capital gains tax that were charged by SARS apparently was also 1.2 million.

MARIUS WENT PERSONALLY TO SARS TO CHECK BECAUSE RENÉ’S NUMBERS DIDN’T MAKE SENSE TO HIM - ONLY TO BE TOLD THAT HE HAD TO WORK THROUGH RENÉ AS THE EXECUTOR.
IN THIS INSTANCE, THE EXECUTOR HAD EXCLUSIVE CONTROL OF THE ESTATE’S BANK ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL AFFAIRS.

Dr Marius De Beer
Soon after I got a phone call from a forensic investigator indicating that they were busy unearthing severe problems, especially regarding trust money, and also matters involving SARS and false audits and all sorts of things so from that moment on, the whole thing just started to dawn upon me, that there was a serious problem here.

THE FORENSIC INVESTIGATOR HANNES OLLEWAGEN HAD BEEN APPROACHED BY SOME OF RENÉ’S ANXIOUS, ANGRY CLIENTS. HE’S BEEN TRYING TO FOLLOW THE MONEY AND THE PAPER TRAILS TOO, MANY WHICH LEAD TO DECEASED ESTATES.

Govan: You opened a can of worms?
Hannes Ollewagen: I think one could say so yes.
Hannes Ollewagen: When you get the mandate to do investigation into a professional person, like a chartered accountant, then you know, you're going to have quite a battle because they know all the processes behind the scenes, how to do the paperwork, what the prosecutor is going to have to look to prove allegations of fraud or misappropriation.

PIECE TO CAM:
It’s scary how much an accountant knows about their clients.
They have their identity documents, their company records, the keys to their bank accounts. But most of all they have their trust.

IN THE CASE OF DENTIST DR JOHAN KLOPPER AND HIS PARTNER MORNÉ LLOYD, RENÉ KRUGER HAD THEIR FRIENDSHIP TOO.

DR JOHAN KLOPPER
René was like a lifetime friend with me. Two three times a day on the phone. Best friends, we did hunting together, going on vacations together. Very, very close friends.

RENE TOOK ON JOHAN’S MOTHER’S ESTATE AFTER HER DEATH IN 2021. BUT THEIR FRIENDSHIP FELL APART WHILE ON HOLIDAY TOGETHER AND WHEN JOHAN TRIED TO REMOVE RENÉ AS EXECUTOR, HE HAD A NASTY SURPRISE.

Govan Whittles: What's this?
Dr Johan Klopper at table: This is the executor letter that been falsified. This is the one that we sent through to the Master's office. And they said to us, the number on that is not on their system. My mother's estate haven't been even registered.

WITH THAT SUSPICIOUS EXECUTOR’S LETTER, RENÉ HAD WITHDRAWN CASH FROM THE ESTATE - JOHAN AND MORNE SUSPECT TO FUND THEIR JOINT HOLIDAY OVER THAT 2021 CHRISTMAS.
WHEN THEY FINALLY GOT THE BANK STATEMENTS THEY SAW TO THEIR SHOCK WITHDRAWALS OF TENS OF THOUSANDS OF RANDS FOR ADMIN OVER THE FESTIVE SEASON AND THEY JUMPED TO THIS CONCLUSION.

MORNÉ LLOYD
So when we saw the bank statements, you know, we could pinpoint all the transactions, you know, this is the money that was spent on food and wine and drinks and booze. This was the money that was spent on a hunting rifle as a Christmas gift for Dawid van Jaarsveld, now her fiancee … I think that is the thing that just angers a person more, you know, because this is somebody that you trusted


BUT THERE WAS ANOTHER LONG-STANDING RELATIONSHIP THAT WAS TO HIT THE ROCKS - BETWEEN RENÉ AND HER SUBCONTRACTOR, JACQUELINE PRETORIUS.
NOW, JACQUELINE CUTS A LONELY FIGURE.
SHE DID BOOKKEEPING WORK ON CLIENT ACCOUNTS, SOLVING PROBLEMS, HANDLING COMPLAINTS, EVEN PERSONALLY DELIVERING FILES TO CLIENTS’ HOMES.

PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles:
In March this year, Rene Kruger dropped a bombshell via whatsapp. She told her clients that she had fired her bookkeeper Jacqueline Pretorius and had laid a charge against her for stealing from deceased estates.
But then assured them there was nothing to worry about.

BUT THIS MESSAGE DID NOT COMFORT WIDOW, WANDA BLIGNAULT AND HER SON. THEY WERE WORRIED - RENE WAS EXECUTOR OF HER LATE HUSBAND’S ESTATE. FRANCOIS BLIGNAULT HAD DIED SIXTEEN MONTHS EARLIER, AND SHE HAD ALREADY PAID RENE 180-THOUSAND RAND BUT THERE WAS ALLEGEDLY NOTHING TO SHOW FOR IT.

WANDA BLIGNAULT
Widow
So there was a high probability that my account was affected as well.

SO WANDA SOUGHT CLARIFICATION ON A PAYMENT SHE HAD MADE TO RENE KRUGER TO SETTLE HER LATE HUSBAND’S BOND IN 2022. JACQUELINE PROMPTLY PAID R114-THOUSAND TO CLEAR THE LOAN, A WHOLE YEAR LATER. BUT A REMAINING EIGHTY-THOUSAND RAND IS IN DISPUTE DUE TO THE LACK OF PROGRESS IN WINDING UP THE ESTATE.

WANDA BLIGNAULT
Widow
I did that myself too, I finally managed to get a TV licence into my own name, his Nedbank bank account closed. They didn't do any of it, Ja.

AFTER RENÉ REFUSED TO STEP DOWN AS EXECUTOR, WANDA HIRED NEW LAWYERS. AND IN THE PAPERS, THEY FOUND A MYSTERIOUS RENTAL STATEMENT.

Wanda at Table showing Govan the document
It states, both mine and my husband's ID numbers …. listing a number 105 Nicholson Street, Brooklyn in Pretoria, as property that we were renting from them. And I had no idea of any of this. I didn't know this property existed.

PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles:
We have come to 105 Nicholson Street, in Brooklyn, Pretoria, and I can see René Kruger’s name on the building, that means she’s definitely had a presence here. Now we are going to try and look for her.

GW: No I don’t think so, I think it’s probably the other side.
Rene Kruger accountants?
Man: Ek weet nie van dit nie. (No, I don’t know them.)

PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles:
René Kruger has gone to ground. And through her lawyer she is refusing to do an interview with us. But she says she’s hired a forensic investigator to do her own inquiry into her bookkeeper.

Note to DAN – try and take out the “Ja” or change it’s tone so the voice isn’t easy to recognise
RENE CLIENT VOICE RECORDINGS:
WORDS ON SCREEN: Rene Kruger talking to a client in March 2023
Ek het ‘n private speurder aangestel om al die boedel rekeninge te ondersoek om alles te ondersoek want ek weet nie hoe ver haar netwerk gestrek het van hierdie werk nie, hierdie onwettige goed nie…

SUBTITLES: I have hired a private detective to investigate all the estate accounts because I don’t know the extent of Jacqueline’s network in these illegal transactions…

JACQUELINE PRETORIUS DECLINED AN INTERVIEW WITH US, BUT CLAIMS THAT RENE FORGED HER SIGNATURE AND IDENTITY ON DOCUMENTS.
SHE RESPONDED TO US IN WRITING, CLAIMING THAT SHE HAD FOR THE MOST PART ACTED UNDER THE INSTRUCTIONS OF RENE KRUGER AS A SUBCONTRACTOR

SHE HAS HER OWN INTERPRETATIONS OF DELAYS, EVENTS AND MOVEMENTS OF CASH.

JACQUELINE SAYS SHE’S HANDED INFORMATION TO INVESTIGATORS.
AND SHE ALLEGES THAT RENE KRUGER AND HER PARTNER, DAWID VAN JAARSVELD, TRIED TO BRIBE HER TO TAKE THE FALL
WHEN SHE REFUSED, SHE SAYS RENE THREATENED HER.

JOHAN AND MORNÉ SAY THEY TOO RECEIVED THREATS.
AFTER THE ANIMOSITY BETWEEN THE TWO COUPLES HAD GROWN,
MORNé RECEIVED THIS PHONE CALL.

Morné: Morné, hello.
Caller: Hello Morné, how are you?
Morné: Good and you

THE CALLER THEN ASKS MORNÉ WHY HE’S TELLING PEOPLE THAT HIS CLIENT HAS A CRIMINAL RECORD.

Note to DAN – beep the fucks 10:17

Morné: What are you going to do to me?
Caller: Listen to me I will make you disappear. I will open a case against you, I will fuck you up, I will fuck you up. I will destroy you.

MORNE SUSPECTS THAT THE MYSTERY CLIENT IS IN FACT RENÉ’S PARTNER, DAVID VAN JAARSVELD. SO WE PHONED TO ASK HIM. THE CONVERSATION QUICKLY GOT HEATED.

Govan Whittles: Dawid, we have spoken to clients of René who allege that René has stolen money from them. We have spoken to multiple people who allege that René has stolen money from them. Those people say that once they fall out with René, you arrange for them to be threatened.

Note to DAN – beep the fucking 10:56
DAWID VAN JAARSVELD: You are sitting next to people who are involved in child pornography, what is your fucking problem man.

GOVAN WHITTLES: Dawid, I am calling from Carte Blanche.

That was Dawid van Jaarsveld, partner of René Kruger, denies that he threatens people and seems to be very upset by our questions.

NONE OF THIS EXPLAINS THE MODUS OPERANDI OF RENE KRUGER CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS, PUZZLING CLIENTS LIKE JOHAN KLOPPER
BETWEEN THE 23RD OF DECEMBER 2021 AND THE 4TH OF FEBRUARY 2022, SOMEBODY MADE 15 WITHDRAWALS FROM THE KLOPPER ACCOUNT.
BUT IN THREE CONSECUTIVE DAYS IN MARCH, ROUGHLY THE SAME AMOUNT WAS PUT BACK, AFTER
LAWYERS REQUESTED THE BANK STATEMENTS.

JOHAN KLOPPER
I think the biggest thing for me … at the time when I had to mourn my mother’s death, and even Morné, he lost his mother and father both three four weeks after my Mum, also to Covid, our parents’ loss we had to deal with this corruption and fraud.

AND THE DRAMA APPEARS EVEN MORE COMPLEX
JOHAN DISCOVERED THAT RENÉ HAD ALSO STOLEN HIS IDENTITY AND USED IT ON HER COMPANY PAPERS

DR JOHAN KLOPPER
I've never signed anything. If you look at the ID's that she used, it is my is my ID but not my photo. Two falsified IDs says she used for the companies. My signature is fraudulent, everything.

JOHAN AND MORNÉ HAVE LAID A COMPLAINT AGAINST RENE KRUGER AT THE SOUTH AFRICAN INSTITUTE OF CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS, SAICA. SHE’S STILL ADVERTISING HER SERVICES, DESPITE THE TRAIL OF DESPAIR SHE OR HER SUBCONTRACTOR LEFT BEHIND.

HANNES OLLEWAGEN IS PUTTING TOGETHER A CASE, ONE BANK ENTRY AT A TIME, ASSISTING OFFICIALS WITH HIS FORENSIC AUDITING SKILLS.

Hannes Ollewagen
Forensic Investigator
There are criminal cases opened that . involves Renee Kruger and Jacqueline Pretorius as suspects of allegations of fraud. And they are currently being investigated.

HE TOO IS FRUSTRATED BY THE PACE OF THE SAICA INVESTIGATION.

Hannes Ollewagen
Forensic Investigator
You know, there's a problem when members of the general public start to contact you, as a forensic investigator complaining to you, crying out for help.

IN 2019 RENE WAS ORDERED TO PAY OVER A MILLION RANDS IN FINES AND COSTS BY THE INDEPENDENT REGULATORY BOARD FOR AUDITORS, IRBA, FOR IMPROPER CONDUCT.
WANDA SAYS SHE FOUND THIS OUT IN THE NEWSPAPERS RECENTLY.
FROM HER PERSPECTIVE, SAICA’S ONGOING INVESTIGATION IS TOO LITTLE TOO LATE.

Two reads here – make the best out of them

WANDA BLIGNAULT
Widow
If the two bodies worked together, and they both disbarred her, then I wouldn't have been in the position where I am now, because she wouldn't have been able to continue practising. And I would have known about it.

MARIUS IS STILL STRUGGLING TO REMOVE RENÉ AS THE EXECUTOR OF HIS MOTHER’S ESTATE, SO HE DOESN’T YET KNOW EXACTLY HOW MUCH OF HIS INHERITANCE IS ACCOUNTED FOR.

I was a Facebook friend of Rene. … I recall very flamboyant pictures of deep sea fishing expeditions and big game hunting trips and, I thought jo, your life is good. It's only actually later that I realised, actually that I think that probably we were sponsoring some of these trips, it may seem.

Summary: This story is about Renee Kruger, a Pretoria accountant who appears to have had a mid-life crisis after her divorce and gone rogue. From being a straight-laced classy Pretoria professional she appears to have become a bit of a vamp with tattoos, mini-skirts and a younger boyfriend, allegedly with a criminal record. But that is not the main problem. The story is about how she turned on trusted clients and siphoned of millions of rands of their money, specifically from deceased estates, while she and her assistant Jacqueline Pretorius were entrusted with managing their financial affairs. She and Jacqueline now accuse each other for the trail of theft after they fell out in March. Renee is the older, experienced company owner, Jacqueline plays the young, naieve and trusting bookkeeper who was implicated without her consent and knowledge. Neither version is completely believable. Untangling the mess is a forensic tax investigator, Hannes Ollewagen. And while he acknowledges that this is an audacious and complex systematic act of fraud, he says it comes in the context of increased abuse of clients by the very people entrusted with their life savings, their trusts and their business accounts. And it appears that one of the regulators that manages the financial industry, the South African Institute of Chartered Accountants, SAICA, stands by and is slow to act against those who have privileged access to other people's bank accounts and personal information, such as ID's and company records. Further information: We have three case studies lined up talk on camera, although I did have off the record conversations with six parties (eight people). 1) Dr Marius De Beer. His parents saved up money for a trust of R1.2 million for his seriously disabled child for after they had passed. Renee Kruger looted the trust fund, leaving R25-thousand. He also did his taxes, and when he started scratching, he found that she had done nothing despite paying monthly for her services and that he now owed SARS huge penalties. SARS is now deducting R17 000 from his salary monthly to make good those penalities. While he battles this, he has had to sell his car. 2) Wanda Blignaut – Renee Kruger stole R100-000 from her husband’s deceased estate – she saw an article about Renee and came forward to volunteer her story 3) Dr Johan Klopper – a close friend of Renee’s who used to go on holiday with her, part of her inner circle. They discovered that she drew R300 000 from his deceased mother’s estate, and have subsequently got threatening phone calls and are victims of a harassment campaign by her boyfriend, Dawid van Jaarsveld. Hannes Olwegen says he can not comment on the case as such as he will be an expert witness in the case. However, as he is a player in this story and I think quite an interesting personality as a foil to the flamboyant Renee Kruger (straight-laced, forensic focus, deliberate and by the book) I have asked him to do an interview which helps to place this case in the context of this type of crime which he says is rife because they are inundated with requests for help from all over the country. A further potential interview/on shoot call could go to Costa Adrianis, a person who runs a hitman agency. Apparently he has been hired/asked by Renées boyfriend to phone up people to intimidate them with death threats. I have his number. There are a number of complicated issues to resolve specifically how to handle Jacqueline Pretorius, how to manage Renée Kruger's confront and also how to manage the first case study Dr Johan Klopper and Morné Kruger, who are more deeply embroiled in the saga on an emotional level because they were once close family friends with Renée and boyfriend, part of a party set that went sour. Hannes is also a little unsure about them. But they have a good story to tell. Finally, I am being sent a lot of voice recordings of Renées conversations with her clients, some of whom don't want to be on camera. What is best ethical practice here? Extra Budget Items: I will be away from my base so will need flight, accommodation, vehicle and S and T. I will hire crew in Pretoria. I am also not sure how possible this is to do in two days given that some of the time would be spent hunting Renee. Add to that the death threats which appear to be part of the strategy to warn people off. Books In the leafy suburbs of Pretoria, there’s a growing tide of mistrust and frustration as a once-respected chartered accountant finds herself in the midst of a forensic investigation. Her disheartened clients allege disturbing delays and puzzling bank withdrawals in the winding up of deceased estates. The investigator is sifting through mountains of paperwork and bank accounts, tracking transactions that link this sophisticated, jet-setting professional and her bookkeeper to a web of hidden irregularities. These allegedly include forged signatures and stolen identities, mysterious changes in company papers and unexplained cash withdrawals and deposits. But this alleged scamster wasn’t just taking from any client: she seemingly targeted those at their most vulnerable – long-time clients and friends dealing with the passing of a loved one. While both the accountant and the bookkeeper have gone to ground, they blame each other for the crimes and misdemeanours of which they stand accused. Carte Blanche investigates. Producer: Marion Edmunds | Presenter: Govan Whittles Script: KRUGER MILLIONS #6547 FINAL SCRIPT PRETORIA, JACARANDA CITY… IT’S HOME TO MANY PROFESSIONALS AND BUSINESS PEOPLE WHO WANT TO KEEP THEIR FINANCIAL AFFAIRS TIDY. AND THIS IS WHERE THE STORY OF RENE KRUGER AND THE MISSING MILLIONS BEGINS… IT’S A SAGA OF COMPLEX FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS AROUND DECEASED ESTATES… FACILITATED BY A CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT WHO RELISHED HOLIDAYS AND THE HIGH LIFE. PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles: For years, accountant Rene Kruger had been handling the books of professionals in Pretoria. Through many tax seasons, she had got to know them well – and they her. But recently, it had become clear to at least some of her clients that things were just not adding up. DR MARIUS DE BEER PLACED HIS FAMILY’S FINANCES WITH RENÉ KRUGER’S SMALL BUSINESS OVER TEN YEARS AGO. SO WHEN HIS MOTHER PASSED AWAY IN 2018, IT SEEMED SENSIBLE TO APPOINT RENÉ AS EXECUTOR OF THE ESTATE, PAYING HER TO DO THE COMPLICATED PAPERWORK REQUIRED BY LAW TO SHIFT HIS INHERITANCE INTO HIS HANDS. THE INHERITANCE WAS IN PART EARMARKED FOR LIFELONG CARE FOR HIS SERIOUSLY DISABLED SON. Dr Marius De Beer It has a very special memory for us that they were able to do that. They spend their lives very disciplined when it came to finances and spending and all that. HOWEVER, MARIUS BECAME UNEASY BECAUSE OVER MONTHS THERE WAS NO MOVEMENT IN THE WRAPPING UP OF THE ESTATE. AND HE WAS CONTINUALLY FOBBED OFF WHEN HE MADE INQUIRIES. Dr Marius De Beer: This is one of the correspondences that I had with Rene regarding my mom's estate where she basically tells me that look, we have to be very patient, it takes long for SARS Govan Whittles: That was obviously just a delaying tactic Dr Marius De Beer: That was a delaying tactic, ja. THEN RENE TOLD HIM SARS WANTED HIM TO PAY A SIGNIFICANT CAPITAL GAINS TAX - WHICH IS A TAX LEVIED ON THE PROFIT MADE FROM THE DISPOSAL OF AN ASSET, LIKE A PROPERTY. Govan Whittles: So at that point, how much money was tied up in your mom's estate? Marius De Beer: Roughly around 1.2 million. And it was, for me at the time, a very surrealistic moment when I heard that the capital gains tax that were charged by SARS apparently was also 1.2 million. MARIUS WENT PERSONALLY TO SARS TO CHECK BECAUSE RENÉ’S NUMBERS DIDN’T MAKE SENSE TO HIM - ONLY TO BE TOLD THAT HE HAD TO WORK THROUGH RENÉ AS THE EXECUTOR. IN THIS INSTANCE, THE EXECUTOR HAD EXCLUSIVE CONTROL OF THE ESTATE’S BANK ACCOUNTS AND FINANCIAL AFFAIRS. Dr Marius De Beer Soon after I got a phone call from a forensic investigator indicating that they were busy unearthing severe problems, especially regarding trust money, and also matters involving SARS and false audits and all sorts of things so from that moment on, the whole thing just started to dawn upon me, that there was a serious problem here. THE FORENSIC INVESTIGATOR HANNES OLLEWAGEN HAD BEEN APPROACHED BY SOME OF RENÉ’S ANXIOUS, ANGRY CLIENTS. HE’S BEEN TRYING TO FOLLOW THE MONEY AND THE PAPER TRAILS TOO, MANY WHICH LEAD TO DECEASED ESTATES. Govan: You opened a can of worms? Hannes Ollewagen: I think one could say so yes. Hannes Ollewagen: When you get the mandate to do investigation into a professional person, like a chartered accountant, then you know, you're going to have quite a battle because they know all the processes behind the scenes, how to do the paperwork, what the prosecutor is going to have to look to prove allegations of fraud or misappropriation. PIECE TO CAM: It’s scary how much an accountant knows about their clients. They have their identity documents, their company records, the keys to their bank accounts. But most of all they have their trust. IN THE CASE OF DENTIST DR JOHAN KLOPPER AND HIS PARTNER MORNÉ LLOYD, RENÉ KRUGER HAD THEIR FRIENDSHIP TOO. DR JOHAN KLOPPER René was like a lifetime friend with me. Two three times a day on the phone. Best friends, we did hunting together, going on vacations together. Very, very close friends. RENE TOOK ON JOHAN’S MOTHER’S ESTATE AFTER HER DEATH IN 2021. BUT THEIR FRIENDSHIP FELL APART WHILE ON HOLIDAY TOGETHER AND WHEN JOHAN TRIED TO REMOVE RENÉ AS EXECUTOR, HE HAD A NASTY SURPRISE. Govan Whittles: What's this? Dr Johan Klopper at table: This is the executor letter that been falsified. This is the one that we sent through to the Master's office. And they said to us, the number on that is not on their system. My mother's estate haven't been even registered. WITH THAT SUSPICIOUS EXECUTOR’S LETTER, RENÉ HAD WITHDRAWN CASH FROM THE ESTATE - JOHAN AND MORNE SUSPECT TO FUND THEIR JOINT HOLIDAY OVER THAT 2021 CHRISTMAS. WHEN THEY FINALLY GOT THE BANK STATEMENTS THEY SAW TO THEIR SHOCK WITHDRAWALS OF TENS OF THOUSANDS OF RANDS FOR ADMIN OVER THE FESTIVE SEASON AND THEY JUMPED TO THIS CONCLUSION. MORNÉ LLOYD So when we saw the bank statements, you know, we could pinpoint all the transactions, you know, this is the money that was spent on food and wine and drinks and booze. This was the money that was spent on a hunting rifle as a Christmas gift for Dawid van Jaarsveld, now her fiancee … I think that is the thing that just angers a person more, you know, because this is somebody that you trusted BUT THERE WAS ANOTHER LONG-STANDING RELATIONSHIP THAT WAS TO HIT THE ROCKS - BETWEEN RENÉ AND HER SUBCONTRACTOR, JACQUELINE PRETORIUS. NOW, JACQUELINE CUTS A LONELY FIGURE. SHE DID BOOKKEEPING WORK ON CLIENT ACCOUNTS, SOLVING PROBLEMS, HANDLING COMPLAINTS, EVEN PERSONALLY DELIVERING FILES TO CLIENTS’ HOMES. PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles: In March this year, Rene Kruger dropped a bombshell via whatsapp. She told her clients that she had fired her bookkeeper Jacqueline Pretorius and had laid a charge against her for stealing from deceased estates. But then assured them there was nothing to worry about. BUT THIS MESSAGE DID NOT COMFORT WIDOW, WANDA BLIGNAULT AND HER SON. THEY WERE WORRIED - RENE WAS EXECUTOR OF HER LATE HUSBAND’S ESTATE. FRANCOIS BLIGNAULT HAD DIED SIXTEEN MONTHS EARLIER, AND SHE HAD ALREADY PAID RENE 180-THOUSAND RAND BUT THERE WAS ALLEGEDLY NOTHING TO SHOW FOR IT. WANDA BLIGNAULT Widow So there was a high probability that my account was affected as well. SO WANDA SOUGHT CLARIFICATION ON A PAYMENT SHE HAD MADE TO RENE KRUGER TO SETTLE HER LATE HUSBAND’S BOND IN 2022. JACQUELINE PROMPTLY PAID R114-THOUSAND TO CLEAR THE LOAN, A WHOLE YEAR LATER. BUT A REMAINING EIGHTY-THOUSAND RAND IS IN DISPUTE DUE TO THE LACK OF PROGRESS IN WINDING UP THE ESTATE. WANDA BLIGNAULT Widow I did that myself too, I finally managed to get a TV licence into my own name, his Nedbank bank account closed. They didn't do any of it, Ja. AFTER RENÉ REFUSED TO STEP DOWN AS EXECUTOR, WANDA HIRED NEW LAWYERS. AND IN THE PAPERS, THEY FOUND A MYSTERIOUS RENTAL STATEMENT. Wanda at Table showing Govan the document It states, both mine and my husband's ID numbers …. listing a number 105 Nicholson Street, Brooklyn in Pretoria, as property that we were renting from them. And I had no idea of any of this. I didn't know this property existed. PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles: We have come to 105 Nicholson Street, in Brooklyn, Pretoria, and I can see René Kruger’s name on the building, that means she’s definitely had a presence here. Now we are going to try and look for her. GW: No I don’t think so, I think it’s probably the other side. Rene Kruger accountants? Man: Ek weet nie van dit nie. (No, I don’t know them.) PIECE TO CAMERA Govan Whittles: René Kruger has gone to ground. And through her lawyer she is refusing to do an interview with us. But she says she’s hired a forensic investigator to do her own inquiry into her bookkeeper. Note to DAN – try and take out the “Ja” or change it’s tone so the voice isn’t easy to recognise RENE CLIENT VOICE RECORDINGS: WORDS ON SCREEN: Rene Kruger talking to a client in March 2023 Ek het ‘n private speurder aangestel om al die boedel rekeninge te ondersoek om alles te ondersoek want ek weet nie hoe ver haar netwerk gestrek het van hierdie werk nie, hierdie onwettige goed nie… SUBTITLES: I have hired a private detective to investigate all the estate accounts because I don’t know the extent of Jacqueline’s network in these illegal transactions… JACQUELINE PRETORIUS DECLINED AN INTERVIEW WITH US, BUT CLAIMS THAT RENE FORGED HER SIGNATURE AND IDENTITY ON DOCUMENTS. SHE RESPONDED TO US IN WRITING, CLAIMING THAT SHE HAD FOR THE MOST PART ACTED UNDER THE INSTRUCTIONS OF RENE KRUGER AS A SUBCONTRACTOR SHE HAS HER OWN INTERPRETATIONS OF DELAYS, EVENTS AND MOVEMENTS OF CASH. JACQUELINE SAYS SHE’S HANDED INFORMATION TO INVESTIGATORS. AND SHE ALLEGES THAT RENE KRUGER AND HER PARTNER, DAWID VAN JAARSVELD, TRIED TO BRIBE HER TO TAKE THE FALL WHEN SHE REFUSED, SHE SAYS RENE THREATENED HER. JOHAN AND MORNÉ SAY THEY TOO RECEIVED THREATS. AFTER THE ANIMOSITY BETWEEN THE TWO COUPLES HAD GROWN, MORNé RECEIVED THIS PHONE CALL. Morné: Morné, hello. Caller: Hello Morné, how are you? Morné: Good and you THE CALLER THEN ASKS MORNÉ WHY HE’S TELLING PEOPLE THAT HIS CLIENT HAS A CRIMINAL RECORD. Note to DAN – beep the fucks 10:17 Morné: What are you going to do to me? Caller: Listen to me I will make you disappear. I will open a case against you, I will fuck you up, I will fuck you up. I will destroy you. MORNE SUSPECTS THAT THE MYSTERY CLIENT IS IN FACT RENÉ’S PARTNER, DAVID VAN JAARSVELD. SO WE PHONED TO ASK HIM. THE CONVERSATION QUICKLY GOT HEATED. Govan Whittles: Dawid, we have spoken to clients of René who allege that René has stolen money from them. We have spoken to multiple people who allege that René has stolen money from them. Those people say that once they fall out with René, you arrange for them to be threatened. Note to DAN – beep the fucking 10:56 DAWID VAN JAARSVELD: You are sitting next to people who are involved in child pornography, what is your fucking problem man. GOVAN WHITTLES: Dawid, I am calling from Carte Blanche. That was Dawid van Jaarsveld, partner of René Kruger, denies that he threatens people and seems to be very upset by our questions. NONE OF THIS EXPLAINS THE MODUS OPERANDI OF RENE KRUGER CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS, PUZZLING CLIENTS LIKE JOHAN KLOPPER BETWEEN THE 23RD OF DECEMBER 2021 AND THE 4TH OF FEBRUARY 2022, SOMEBODY MADE 15 WITHDRAWALS FROM THE KLOPPER ACCOUNT. BUT IN THREE CONSECUTIVE DAYS IN MARCH, ROUGHLY THE SAME AMOUNT WAS PUT BACK, AFTER LAWYERS REQUESTED THE BANK STATEMENTS. JOHAN KLOPPER I think the biggest thing for me … at the time when I had to mourn my mother’s death, and even Morné, he lost his mother and father both three four weeks after my Mum, also to Covid, our parents’ loss we had to deal with this corruption and fraud. AND THE DRAMA APPEARS EVEN MORE COMPLEX JOHAN DISCOVERED THAT RENÉ HAD ALSO STOLEN HIS IDENTITY AND USED IT ON HER COMPANY PAPERS DR JOHAN KLOPPER I've never signed anything. If you look at the ID's that she used, it is my is my ID but not my photo. Two falsified IDs says she used for the companies. My signature is fraudulent, everything. JOHAN AND MORNÉ HAVE LAID A COMPLAINT AGAINST RENE KRUGER AT THE SOUTH AFRICAN INSTITUTE OF CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS, SAICA. SHE’S STILL ADVERTISING HER SERVICES, DESPITE THE TRAIL OF DESPAIR SHE OR HER SUBCONTRACTOR LEFT BEHIND. HANNES OLLEWAGEN IS PUTTING TOGETHER A CASE, ONE BANK ENTRY AT A TIME, ASSISTING OFFICIALS WITH HIS FORENSIC AUDITING SKILLS. Hannes Ollewagen Forensic Investigator There are criminal cases opened that . involves Renee Kruger and Jacqueline Pretorius as suspects of allegations of fraud. And they are currently being investigated. HE TOO IS FRUSTRATED BY THE PACE OF THE SAICA INVESTIGATION. Hannes Ollewagen Forensic Investigator You know, there's a problem when members of the general public start to contact you, as a forensic investigator complaining to you, crying out for help. IN 2019 RENE WAS ORDERED TO PAY OVER A MILLION RANDS IN FINES AND COSTS BY THE INDEPENDENT REGULATORY BOARD FOR AUDITORS, IRBA, FOR IMPROPER CONDUCT. WANDA SAYS SHE FOUND THIS OUT IN THE NEWSPAPERS RECENTLY. FROM HER PERSPECTIVE, SAICA’S ONGOING INVESTIGATION IS TOO LITTLE TOO LATE. Two reads here – make the best out of them WANDA BLIGNAULT Widow If the two bodies worked together, and they both disbarred her, then I wouldn't have been in the position where I am now, because she wouldn't have been able to continue practising. And I would have known about it. MARIUS IS STILL STRUGGLING TO REMOVE RENÉ AS THE EXECUTOR OF HIS MOTHER’S ESTATE, SO HE DOESN’T YET KNOW EXACTLY HOW MUCH OF HIS INHERITANCE IS ACCOUNTED FOR. Two reads here – make the best out of them Marius De Beer Medical Doctor I was a Facebook friend of Rene. … I recall very flamboyant pictures of deep sea fishing expeditions and big game hunting trips and, I thought jo, your life is good. It's only actually later that I realised, actually that I think that probably we were sponsoring some of these trips, it may seem. PROMOS AND PRESENTER LINK TO CAMERA PROMO 1 14:38 IN PRETORIA, A CHARTERED ACCOUNTANT LOSES HER CLIENT’S TRUST…. Marius De Beer My worst fear was that she, she took our inheritance. That was the first time this actually dawned on me that this was actually a possibility, that the trust money could be gone PROMO 2 15:08 DISTRACTED BY DEATH AND PAPERWORK, IT’S SURPRISINGLY EASY TO LOSE CONTROL OF AN INHERITANCE JOHAN KLOPPER Dentist GW: You're saying that the executor’s letter was forged? JK: It was forged because we actually spoke to the Head Master and she said to me they’ve had nothing about my mother’s estate. And then the money already have been withdrawn from my mother’s estate. PROMO 3 15:38 STEALING FROM THE GRAVE…. GW: So at that point how much was tied up in your Mum’s estate? Marius De Beer: Roughly about 1.2 million. While he battles this, he has had to sell his car. 2) Wanda Blignaut – Renee Kruger stole R100-000 from her husband’s deceased estate – she saw an article about Renee and came forward to volunteer her story 3) Dr Johan Klopper – a close friend of Renee’s who used to go on holiday with her, part of her inner circle. They discovered that she drew R300 000 from his deceased mother’s estate, and have subsequently got threatening phone calls and are victims of a harassment campaign by her boyfriend, Dawid van Jaarsveld. Hannes Olwegen says he can not comment on the case as such as he will be an expert witness in the case. However, as he is a player in this story and I think quite an interesting personality as a foil to the flamboyant Renee Kruger (straight-laced, forensic focus, deliberate and by the book) I have asked him to do an interview which helps to place this case in the context of this type of crime which he says is rife because they are inundated with requests for help from all over the country. A further potential interview/on shoot call could go to Costa Adrianis, a person who runs a hitman agency. Apparently he has been hired/asked by Renées boyfriend to phone up people to intimidate them with death threats. I have his number. There are a number of complicated issues to resolve specifically how to handle Jacqueline Pretorius, how to manage Renée Kruger's confront and also how to manage the first case study Dr Johan Klopper and Morné Kruger, who are more deeply embroiled in the saga on an emotional level because they were once close family friends with Renée and boyfriend, part of a party set that went sour. Hannes is also a little unsure about them. But they have a good story to tell. Finally, I am being sent a lot of voice recordings of Renées conversations with her clients, some of whom don't want to be on camera. What is best ethical practice here?
